name: Beguiler’s Arcana (Sp)
body:
Benefit: The saboteur learns a handful of minor magical knacks. Choose any four spells from the following list: daze, detect magic, ghost sound, light, lullaby, mage hand, open/close, prestidigitation, read magic, sift, spark, or unwitting ally. The saboteur can cast these spells at- will, using her saboteur level as her caster level. The DC of these spells is equal to 10 + her Intelligence bonus.
